metadata.title: Why Are Stocks Falling When Earnings Beat the Street?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Are Stocks Falling When Earnings Beat the Street?
Being an optimist about stocks right now feels a little like Kevin Bacon’s character screaming “All is Well!” at the end of the 1978 comedy Animal House.
